mapper.select: SELECT board_seq AS boardSeq, user_seq AS userSeq, category, board_title AS boardTitle, board_content AS boardContent, view_count AS viewCount, board_writedate AS boardWritedate, board_update AS boardUpdate FROM board ORDER BY board_writedate DESC

SELECT board_seq AS boardSeq, user_seq AS userSeq, category, board_title AS boardTitle, board_content AS boardContent, view_count AS viewCount, board_writedate AS boardWritedate, board_update AS boardUpdate FROM board WHERE board_seq = #{boardSeq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (user_seq, category, board_title, board_content) VALUES (#{userSeq}, #{category}, #{boardTitle}, #{boardContent})
